name: English
_note: The words of the first-boot flow (structure: first_boot.json). Every step has 'say' (the offer, spoken), 'screen' (what the panel shows: a title and one short line) and 'done'; most have 'later'. 'common' holds the lines every step shares. House voice: short, warm, honest; never promise what she cannot do, never say a step is done before the system says so. A spoken line is at most 'max_chars'. {room}, {panel}, {time} and {day} are filled by the caller; nothing else is a placeholder. Unreviewed draft: the owner reviews the words before any of this is wired.

common.rephrase: Sorry, I didn't catch that. You can say yes, or later.
common.repeat: I'm still here whenever you're ready.
common.park: I'll pause setup here. Say 'carry on with setup', or tap the card, and I'll pick up where we left off.

park_screen.title: Setup paused
park_screen.body: Tap to carry on where we left off.

common.ask_adult: I need a grown-up for this part. Could you fetch the person setting me up?
common.help: That didn't work, and I can't fix it from here. The card on screen says what happened. It's safe to try again later.

help_screen.title: Something went wrong
help_screen.body: Scan the code on your phone for what to do next.

common.deferred: No problem. I'll leave that for now and ask again another day.

hello.say: Hi, I'm Zoe. Let's get you set up. The important part takes about ten minutes, and you can stop any time. Shall we start?

screen.title: Hi, I'm Zoe
screen.body: Say 'yes' or tap Start. About ten minutes.

owner_account.say: First I need to know who looks after me. Scan the code with your phone and make your account there.

screen.title: Make your account
screen.body: Scan with your phone. You'll choose a password there, not here.

owner_account.explain: I can't do anything useful until someone looks after me, so this one comes first. The code stays on screen.
owner_account.done: Thanks. You're the owner now, so you can change any of this later.

forget_secret.say: I'm setting up how I keep forgotten things forgotten. This takes a second.

panel_paired.say: Now I'll connect this screen to your account. Scan the code with the same phone.

screen.title: Connect this screen
screen.body: Scan with your phone and tap Confirm.

panel_paired.explain: This screen needs to be connected before I can learn your voice here. The code stays on screen.

panel_named.say: Which room is this screen in? Say the room, like kitchen or lounge.
panel_named.later: That's fine. I'll call it 'this screen' for now.
panel_named.done: Got it. This is the {room} screen.

time_and_place.say: I think it's {time} on {day}. Is that right?

screen.title: Time and place
screen.body: {time}, {day}. Say yes, or tell me the right time.

time_and_place.later: Okay. Until we fix it, my times might be off.
time_and_place.done: Thanks. Reminders and alarms will use that time.

owner_pin.say: Pick a four-digit PIN on the screen. It unlocks your private things here, like your calendar.

screen.title: Choose a PIN
screen.body: Four digits. Only you should know it.

owner_pin.later: Okay. Without a PIN I can't learn your voice yet, so we'll come back to that too.

owner_voice.say: Now I'd like to learn your voice. You'll read three short lines. I keep a voice signature, not recordings, and you can delete it. Ready?

screen.title: Learn my voice
screen.body: Three short lines. A signature, not recordings.

owner_voice.later: That's fine. Just say 'learn my voice' whenever you like.
owner_voice.done: Thanks, I know your voice now.

phone_linked.say: Want me to be able to reach your phone, for reminders when you're out? Scan the code to link it.

screen.title: Link your phone
screen.body: Scan to get reminders on your phone.

phone_linked.later: Okay. Reminders will stay on this screen for now.

backup_target.say: What I remember lives here, in this box. If you'd like a safe copy somewhere else, scan the code to choose where.

screen.title: Keep a safe copy
screen.body: Optional. Choose where, on your phone.

backup_target.later: Okay. Nothing is copied anywhere until you choose. I'll ask again another day.

first_win.say: That's the important part done. Want to try something? Ask me to remind you about something, or add milk to the shopping list.

screen.title: Try me
screen.body: 'Remind me to call the plumber at nine.'

first_win.later: No rush. Just talk to me when you need something.

more_members.say: Does anyone else live here? I can make each person their own account, so I don't mix you up.

screen.title: Who else lives here?
screen.body: Each person scans their own code.

more_members.later: Okay. You can add people any time.

child_marked.say: Is anyone in the house a child? I talk to children differently, and some things stay with the grown-ups.

screen.title: Children
screen.body: Tell me which accounts are children.

child_marked.later: Okay. Until you tell me, I'll treat every account as a grown-up.
child_marked.done: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.

calendar.say: Want me to see your calendar? Scan the code and sign in on your phone.

screen.title: Connect your calendar
screen.body: Sign in on your phone, not here.

calendar.later: Okay. I'll keep my own list of events for you.

music.say: Want music? Scan the code to connect your music service.
music.later: Okay. Just ask when you want music set up.

done.say: That's us set up. If anything's still missing, I'll mention it when we talk.
